question: In what form is the vital air said to be present within all living beings?
premises: The subject is the air filled with breath.
This air is located in all beings.
It is described as situated there.
inference: The breath-filled vital air abides within all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam is irregular in the transmitted form.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
